risks.if_unproven: priced as lower-grade material (e.g., galvanized steel), which is cheaper than aluminum.

risks.risk: The 50-year guarantee is not genuine or is not backed by any warranty document.
risks.proof: A scanned copy of the warranty document or a certificate from the manufacturer.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having no guarantee, reducing value.

risks.risk: Photo 2 is AI-generated or stock imagery, not a real factory or worker, suggesting the seller may not actually produce the sheets.
risks.proof: A real-time video or photo of the factory floor, machinery, and workers without watermark or AI artifacts.
